claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Google 的下一版 Deschutes 規格或 Google 一手文件改為不用液對液 CDU（例：改液對氣或廠務水直入機櫃）。核查頻率：每次 OCP 高峰會（每年兩次）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註或提撤回，重讀 CDU 層需求側。
claims.statement: Google's own CDU specification (Project Deschutes, contributed to OCP, final 2025-09-05) is written by Google as the 'customer' for its CDU 'vendors', drawing on 'more than 7 years of scale liquid cooling experience at Google', and opens the design to 'any CDU supplier in the industry'. Buyer-side document: Google depends on liquid-to-liquid CDUs and deliberately multi-sources the CDU itself.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Deschutes 下一版改列別家為第一來源，或 CDU 廠文件寫出不用 Alfa Laval 的 Deschutes 熱交換器而成為主流。核查頻率：每次 OCP 高峰會＋每季（CDU 廠上架頁）。觸發後 48 小時：e2 的 qualification_status 改寫、重讀板式熱交換器層。
claims.statement: In Google's Deschutes CDU specification the heat exchanger is specified as 'First source vendor: Alfa Laval ● Model: CB210-276AH', three in parallel per 2 MW CDU — the buyer names the supplier (designed_in at the spec level). The same spec says components are 'sourced from multiple vendors that are widely known in the industry', so 'first source' is not sole source; no second source is named.

source_doc.permission_basis: 開放規格（OCP 文件）；只保留研究必要的逐字摘錄。published_at 取 OCP 文件名的定稿日 2025-09-05（公開可得日；規格頁尾寫 Date: July 01, 2025 是內文版本日）。PDF 文字層斷行多，引文已把空白攤平。
source_doc.title: Project Deschutes: Data Center Facilities 0.80.0 Specification（Google 提交 OCP 的第五代 CDU 規格）

sources.quote: The specification will enable any CDU supplier in the industry to develop, manufacture and improve upon the “Project Deschutes” design which is informed by more than 7 years of scale liquid cooling experience at Google.
The “Project Deschutes” CDU is assembled from components that are sourced from multiple vendors that are widely known in the industry.
6.2 Heat Exchanger ● First source vendor: Alfa Laval ● Model: CB210-276AH ● Two pass heat exchanger ● 3 heat exchangers in parallel for lower pressure drop and thermal performance
The term “customer” used in this document refers to Google ● The term “vendor” used in this document refers to the CDU provider.
